_comment: The dependency-prepared series. Kept apart from repositories.json (the dependency-free series):
the harness refuses a manifest that mixes the two, and reports the series in every result.
Preparation copies the pinned checkout and extracts ONE package tarball, pinned by exact version
and sha512 integrity, into node_modules/<package>. Nothing is installed and no package script runs.
Network is used only to fetch that tarball (once; it is cached beside the checkouts).

repositories.purpose: A small TypeScript library whose tsconfig extends a shared config package: the cost of a run once that one configuration package is present.

setup.notes: Profile tsconfig-only: only the package tsconfig.json extends. No @types, no dependencies of ky: '@type-challenges/utils' (imported by source/core/constants.ts) stays unresolved, as dependencies do in the dependency-free series.
